title: Desaparecidos’ kin urged to continue loved ones’ fight for justice

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — On All Souls’ Day, families of enforced disappearances (desaparecidos) were urged to continue to fight for justice and carry on the causes their missing loved ones championed, even with no bodies or graves to visit.
